acceptance: Published bundles record the exact capacity SKU (Fabric F4/F64, Redshift RPU base and region, Athena credit account type)
Trial-capacity numbers are labeled so they are never compared as production equivalents
Validator or submission docs enforce the field
context: Found during 2026-10-06 review of free-trial offers: Redshift $300/90d, AWS $200/6mo, and Fabric 60d F4-or-F64 trials would otherwise enter the corpus indistinguishable from paid capacity.
description: Require capacity disclosure for any benchmark bundle produced on trial or credit capacity: record trial versus paid, the exact SKU, and the account type in bundle metadata and enforce it at submission time. Covers Fabric F4/F64, Redshift Serverless RPU base, and Athena shared-credit runs.
